items.title: Cursor AI Extension Access Developer Tokens Leads to Full Credential Compromise
items.description: A high-severity access-control vulnerability (CVSS 8.2) in Cursor, a widely used AI-powered coding environment. The flaw uncovered by LayerX has allowed any installed extension to access a developer’s API keys and session tokens secretly. This results in total credential compromise without triggering any alerts or requiring user interaction. Unlike secure applications that store sensitive…

items.title: Linux Kernel 0-Day “Copy Fail” Roots Every Major Distribution Since 2017
items.description: A critical zero-day vulnerability in the Linux kernel has been publicly disclosed, enabling any unprivileged local user to obtain root access on virtually every major Linux distribution shipped since 2017. items.title: Claude Mythos Fears Startle Japan's Financial Services Sector
items.description: Global financial institutions are panicked over Anthropic's new superhacker AI model. Cyber experts aren't quite as worried.

The vendor is given until 2026-08-27 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
